name: Stephen Burnett
role: Young Ohio elder called on missions in 1832
dateNote: Section 75 named him in January 1832, and section 80 was given to him on 7 March 1832, at age eighteen.
importance: Stephen Burnett was baptized in Ohio in November 1830 and ordained a high priest in October 1831. Section 75 pairs him with Ruggles Eames, and section 80 tells him to preach with Eden Smith as companion. He served in New Hampshire and other eastern states from 1832 to 1834. He left the Church by 1838 and later became a Disciples of Christ elder.
connections: His named companions are Ruggles Eames (75:35) and Eden Smith (80:2).

sources.title: Stephen Burnett, Joseph Smith Papers biography
